lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. The medial row exhibits the highest intensity and most regular spatial intervals, extending towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, forming a loose grid pattern with spots situated at the intersection nodes, most visible in the mid-lateral flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and low-intensity shadow pixels immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the lower anterior region of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip and trailing edge of the left pectoral fin show irregular white pigmentation and minor structural fraying. No large-scale traumatic lesions are visible.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, slender teleost (likely a remora) is attached to the lateral flank, positioned ventrally to the second carinal ridge.
